stem.text: Which statement about Group 17 elements and compounds is correct?

A.text: Sodium chloride produces chlorine when reacted with concentrated sulfuric acid.

B.text: Sodium chloride produces chlorine when reacted with bromine.

C.text: Sodium bromide produces bromine when reacted with concentrated sulfuric acid.

D.text: Sodium bromide produces bromine when reacted with iodine in aqueous potassium iodide.
